name: instruxi
description: The Instruxi kit for Claude Code: Enforcer itself, its files, the Enforcer governor and the enforcer-graph planner, plus Jev hooks for Instruxi staff.

plugins.name: enforcer
plugins.description: Connects your agent to your Enforcer workspace as an Agent Plugins 1.0 package (root plugin.json, mcp.json, skills) with a Claude Code fallback: the enforcer MCP server, one sign-in (/enforcer:login), /enforcer:setup, workspace switching. Includes the graph worker and the governor.

plugins.name: enforcer-governor
plugins.description: DEPRECATED: now part of enforcer. Install enforcer instead (`claude plugin install enforcer@instruxi`); this alias goes away after one release.

plugins.name: jev-hooks
plugins.description: Claude Code hooks (public, maintained separately by its author; needs your own TypeSafe key) backed by TypeSafe's Jev: a Bash and edit risk gate, subagent model routing, subagent verification, a stop self-check, loop detection and compaction triage.
